newsitem.title: USA: U.S. appliance shipments slip, record '96 seen.
newsitem.headline: U.S. appliance shipments slip, record '96 seen.

text.p: Home appliance shipments declined three percent in November, the Association of Home Appliance Manufacturers reports, although it still expects 1996 to be the best year ever in total product shipments.
In November, total shipments were 4.1 million units compared with 4.2 million in the same 1995 period. Year to date, shipments rose 4.6 percent to 50.9 million units from 48.7 million.
The industry trade group said it still expects 1996 to set a new record for total shipments. The previous best year was 1994 when the industry shipped 53.5 million products.
